title: Freestanding Paper Towel Holder 14-Inch Solid Brass Weighted Base, Countertop Holder Stand | Allied Brass
description:
Keep your counter neat with a freestanding paper towel holder made from solid brass and built with a weighted base to help prevent tipping. A clean, crisp choice for modern bathroom hardware and contemporary bath accessories styling, and a smart fit for minimalist bathroom fixtures where clutter-free counters matter.

Highlights:
- Countertop paper towel holder stand with freestanding placement (no wall mount needed)
- Crafted from solid brass materials
- Weighted base helps resist tipping while pulling sheets
- Felt pad helps prevent scratching on surfaces
- Offered in many lifetime designer finishes, including distinctive statement colors

Specs:
- Dimensions: 14-Inch height; 5-Inch length; 5-Inch width
- Product weight: 4.8 lb
- Material: Brass
- Assembly required: No
- Included items: Paper towel holder
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
